title: Regression of R15-CODE-DATA-001 (class R15-LEAD-059): NSE SME GSTL (Globesecure Technologies) is stamped with BSE GSTL Globalspace Technologies' ISIN/scrip code, so its announcements, results calendar, corporate actions and shareholding splits merge a different company's BSE filings
repro: GET /resolve?q=GSTL (IN) -> NSE Globesecure Technologies, confidence 1.0, needs_disambiguation false, isin INE632W01016, bse_code 540654 (that is BSE Globalspace Technologies; NSE Emerge SME_EQUITY_L.csv gives Globesecure ISIN INE00WS01056). Same sidecar: /disclosures/results?symbol=GSTL lists 10 events with company 'GlobalSpace Technologies Limited' exchange BSE; /disclosures/announcements?symbol=GSTL merges BSE rows of Globalspace beside NSE Globesecure rows; /disclosures/corporate-actions?symbol=GSTL mixes a BSE rights issue and a BSE final dividend 0.2 into GSTL's actions; /disclosures/shareholding carries split_source BSE (FII 0.15%). Mechanism: symbol_resolver._bse_row_is_same_company (:1493-1511) accepts the BSE row when SequenceMatcher(_company_name_key) >= _SAME_COMPANY_NAME_RATIO 0.75 (:1480); 'globesecuretechnologies' vs 'globalspacetechnologies' scores 0.826, so dual_listed_bse_code (:768) returns 540654 and _enrich_instrument stamps the ISIN. The shared 'technologies' suffix dominates the ratio.
